title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
abstract: arXiv:2606.28733v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are expected to act over multiple turns, using search, browsing interfaces, and tools to complete user goals. Yet not every goal is well specified or achievable in an available environment. In such cases, a reliable agent should recognize that further interaction is unlikely to help and abstain from additional tool calls. We define Agentic Abstention, the problem of deciding when an agent should stop acting under uncertainty. Unlike standard LLM abstention, which is usually evaluated as a single-turn answer-or-abstain decision, agentic abstention is a sequential decision problem: an agent can answer, abstain, or gather more information at each turn, and the need to abstain may only become clear after interacting with the environment. translated_title: 智能体弃权：智能体知道何时应该停止而非行动吗？
translated_abstract: LLM智能体被期望在多轮交互中采取行动，利用搜索、浏览界面和工具来完成用户目标。然而，并非所有目标都被清晰定义，或在可用环境中能够实现。在这种情况下，可靠的智能体应当认识到进一步交互不太可能有帮助，从而放弃额外的工具调用。我们定义了“智能体弃权”这一问题，即决定智能体在不确定性下何时应停止行动。与标准LLM弃权通常被评估为单轮的“回答或弃权”决策不同，智能体弃权是一个序列决策问题：智能体在每一轮可以选择回答、弃权或收集更多信息，而弃权的必要性可能只有在与环境交互之后才会变得明确。我们在网页购物、终端环境和问答任务上研究了这个问题，评估了13个以LLM作为智能体的系统和2个智能体脚手架，涵盖超过28,000条任务指令。我们的研究…
tldr: 该论文提出了“智能体弃权”这一新概念，将LLM智能体在多轮交互中判断何时应停止行动定义为序列决策问题，并在超过28,000条任务指令上评估了13个LLM智能体系统和2个智能体脚手架。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "Agentic Abstention," a novel sequential decision problem of determining when LLM agents should stop acting under uncertainty, and evaluates 13 LLM-as-agent systems and 2 agent scaffolds across web shopping, terminal, and QA environments on over 28,000 task instructions.
